2.t: These are the verses of the Book, rich in wisdom

3.t: ˹It is˺ a guide and mercy for the good-doers—

4.t: those who establish prayer, pay alms-tax, and have sure faith in the Hereafter
4.tr: Allazeena yuqeemoonas Salaata Wa-yu'toonaz Zakaata Wa-hum bil-Aakhirati hum yooqinoon

5.t: It is they who are ˹truly˺ guided by their Lord, and it is they who will be successful
5.tr: Ulaaa'ika 'alaa hudam mir Rabbihim Wa-ulaaa'ika humul muflihoon

6.t: But there are some who employ theatrics, only to lead others away from Allah’s Way—without any knowledge—and to make a mockery of it. They will suffer a humiliating punishment
6.tr: Wa-minan naasi maien yashtaree lahuwal hadeesi li-yudilla 'an sabeelil laahi bighairi 'ilminw Wa-yattakhizahaa huzuwaa; ulaaa'ika lahum 'azaabum muheen

7.t: Whenever Our revelations are recited to them, they turn away in arrogance as if they did not hear them, as if there is deafness in their ears. So give them good news ˹O Prophet˺ of a painful punishment
7.tr: Wa-izaa tutlaa 'alayhi Aayaatunaa wallaa mustakbiran ka-al lam yasma'haa ka-anna feee uzunaihi waqran fabash-shiru bi'azaabin aleem

8.t: Surely those who believe and do good will have the Gardens of Bliss
8.tr: Innal lazeena aamanoo Wa-'amilus saalihaati lahum Janaatun Na'eem

9.t: staying there forever. Allah’s promise is true. And He is the Almighty, All-Wise
9.tr: Khaalideena feeha wa'dal laahi haqqaa; Wa-Huwal 'Azeezul Hakeem

10.t: He created the heavens without pillars—as you can see—and placed firm mountains upon the earth so it does not shake with you, and scattered throughout it all types of creatures. And We send down rain from the sky, causing every type of fine plant to grow on earth
10.tr: Khalaqas samaawaati bi-ghairi 'amadin tarawnahaa Wa-alqaa fil ardi rawaasiya an tameeda bikum Wa-bassa feehaa min kulli daaabbah; Wa-anzalnaa minas samaaa'i maaa'an fa-ambatnaa feeha min kulli zawjin kareem

11.t: This is Allah’s creation. Now show Me what those ˹gods˺ other than Him have created. In fact, the wrongdoers are clearly astray
11.tr: Haazaa khalqul laahi fa-aroonee maazaa khalaqal lazeena min doonih; baliz zaalimoona fee dalalim Mubeen

12.t: Indeed, We blessed Luqmân with wisdom, ˹saying˺, “Be grateful to Allah, for whoever is grateful, it is only for their own good. And whoever is ungrateful, then surely Allah is Self-Sufficient, Praiseworthy.”
12.tr: Wa-laqad aatainaa Luqmaanal hikmata anish kur lillaah; Wa-maien yashkur fa-innamaa yashkuru linafsihee Wa-man kafara fa-innal laaha Ghaniyyun Hameed

13.t: And ˹remember˺ when Luqmân said to his son, while advising him, “O my dear son! Never associate ˹anything˺ with Allah ˹in worship˺, for associating ˹others with Him˺ is truly the worst of all wrongs.”
13.tr: Wa-iz qaala luqmaanu libnihee Wa-huwa ya'izuhoo ya-bunaiya laa tushrik billaah; innash shirka lazulmun 'azeem

14.t: And We have commanded people to ˹honour˺ their parents. Their mothers bore them through hardship upon hardship, and their weaning takes two years. So be grateful to Me and your parents. To Me is the final return
14.tr: Wa-wassainal insaana bi-waalidaihi hamalat hu ummuhoo wahnan 'alaa wahninw Wa-fisaaluhoo fee 'aamaini anishkur lee Wa-liwaalidaika ilaiyal maseer

15.t: But if they pressure you to associate with Me what you have no knowledge of, do not obey them. Still keep their company in this world courteously, and follow the way of those who turn to Me ˹in devotion˺. Then to Me you will ˹all˺ return, and then I will inform you of what you used to do
15.tr: Wa-in jaahadaaka 'alaaa an tushrika bee maa laisa laka bihee 'ilmun falaa tuti'humaa Wa-saahib-humaa fid dunyaa ma'roofanw wattabi' sabeela man anaaba ilayy; summa ilaiyya marji'ukum fa-unabbi'ukum bimaa kuntum ta'maloon

16.t: ˹Luqmân added,˺ “O my dear son! ˹Even˺ if a deed were the weight of a mustard seed—be it ˹hidden˺ in a rock or in the heavens or the earth—Allah will bring it forth. Surely Allah is Most Subtle, All-Aware
16.tr: Ya-bunaiya innahaaa in taku misqaala habbatim min khardalin fatakun fee sakhratin aw fis samaawaati aw fil ardi yaati bihal laa; innal laaha lateefun Khabeer

17.t: “O my dear son! Establish prayer, encourage what is good and forbid what is evil, and endure patiently whatever befalls you. Surely this is a resolve to aspire to
17.tr: Yaa bunaiya aqimis-Salaata waamur bilma'roofi wanha 'anil munkari wasbir 'alaa maaa asaabaka inna zaalika min 'azmil umoor

18.t: “And do not turn your nose up to people, nor walk pridefully upon the earth. Surely Allah does not like whoever is arrogant, boastful
18.tr: Wa-laa tusa'-ir khaddaka linnaasi Wa-laa tamshi fil ardi maarahan innal laaha laa yuhibbu kulla mukhtaalin fakhoor

19.t: Be moderate in your pace. And lower your voice, for the ugliest of all voices is certainly the braying of donkeys.”
19.tr: Waqsid fee mashyika waghdud min sawtik; inna ankaral aswaati lasawtul hameer

20.t: Have you not seen that Allah has subjected for you whatever is in the heavens and whatever is on the earth, and has lavished His favours upon you, both seen and unseen? ˹Still˺ there are some who dispute about Allah without knowledge, or guidance, or an enlightening scripture
20.tr: Alam taraw annal laaha sakhkhara lakum maa fis sa-maawaati Wa-maa fil ardi Wa-asbaha 'alaikum ni'amahoo zaahiratanw Wa-baatinah; Wa-minan naasi many yujaadilu fil laahi bighayri 'ilminw Wa-laa hudanw Wa-laa Kitaabim muneer

21.t: When it is said to them, “Follow what Allah has revealed,” they reply, “No! We ˹only˺ follow what we found our forefathers practicing.” ˹Would they still do so˺ even if Satan is inviting them to the torment of the Blaze
21.tr: Wa-izaa qeela lahumut tabi'oo maaa anzalal laahu qaaloo bal nattabi'u maa wajadnaa 'alaihi aabaaa'anaa; awalaw kaanash Shaitaanu yad'oohum ilaa 'azaabis sa'eer

22.t: Whoever fully submits themselves to Allah and is a good-doer, they have certainly grasped the firmest hand-hold. And with Allah rests the outcome of ˹all˺ affairs
22.tr: Wa-maien yuslim wajha-hooo ilal laahi Wa-huwa muhsinun faqadistamsaka bil'ur watil wusqaa; Wa-ilal laahi 'aaqibatul umoor

23.t: But whoever disbelieves, do not let their disbelief grieve you ˹O Prophet˺. To Us is their return, and We will inform them of all they did. Surely Allah knows best what is ˹hidden˺ in the heart
23.tr: Wa-man kafara falaa yahzunka kufruh; ilainaa marji'uhum fanunabbi'uhum bimaa 'amiloo; innal laaha 'aleemum bizaatis sudoor

24.t: We allow them enjoyment for a little while, then ˹in time˺ We will force them into a harsh torment
24.tr: Numatti'uhum qaleelan summa nadtarruhum ilaa 'azaabin ghaleez

25.t: And if you ask them who created the heavens and the earth, they will definitely say, “Allah!” Say, “Praise be to Allah!” In fact, most of them do not know
25.tr: Wa-la'in sa-altahum man khalaqas samaawaati wal-arda la-yaqoolunnal laah; qulil hamdu lillaah; bal aksaruhum laa ya'lamoon

26.t: To Allah belongs whatever is in the heavens and the earth. Allah is truly the Self-Sufficient, Praiseworthy
26.tr: Lilaahi ma fis samaa-waati wal-ard; innal laaha Huwal Ghaniyyul Hameed

27.t: If all the trees on earth were pens and the ocean ˹were ink˺, refilled by seven other oceans, the Words of Allah would not be exhausted. Surely Allah is Almighty, All-Wise
27.tr: Wa-law annamaa fil ardi min shajaratin aqlaamunw wal-bahru yamudduhoo mim ba'dihee sab'atu abhurim maa nafidat Kalimaatul laah; innal laaha 'azeezun Hakeem

28.t: The creation and resurrection of you ˹all˺ is as simple ˹for Him˺ as that of a single soul. Surely Allah is All-Hearing, All-Seeing
28.tr: Maa khalqukum Wa-laa ba'sukum illaa kanafsinw-waa hidah; innal laaha Samee'um Baseer

29.t: Do you not see that Allah causes the night to merge into the day and the day into the night, and has subjected the sun and the moon, each orbiting for an appointed term, and that Allah is All-Aware of what you do
29.tr: Alam tara annal laaha yoolijul laila fin nahaari Wa-yoolijun nahaara fil laili Wa-sakhkharash shamsa wal-qamara kulluny yajreee ilaaa ajalim musammanw Wa-annal laaha bimaa ta'maloona Khabeer

30.t: That is because Allah ˹alone˺ is the Truth and what they invoke besides Him is falsehood, and ˹because˺ Allah ˹alone˺ is the Most High, All-Great
30.tr: Zaalika bi-annal laaha Huwal Haqqu Wa-anna maa yad'oona min doonihil baatilu Wa-annal laaha Huwal 'Aliyyul Kabeer

31.t: Do you not see that the ships sail ˹smoothly˺ through the sea by the grace of Allah so that He may show you some of His signs? Surely in this are signs for whoever is steadfast, grateful
31.tr: Alam tara annal fulka tajree fil bahri bini'matil laahi li-yuriyakum min Aayaatih; inna fee zaalika la-Aayaatil likulli sabbaarin shakoor

32.t: And as soon as they are overwhelmed by waves like mountains, they cry out to Allah ˹alone˺ in sincere devotion. But when He delivers them ˹safely˺ to shore, only some become relatively grateful. And none rejects Our signs except whoever is deceitful, ungrateful
32.tr: Wa-izaa ghashiyahum mawjun kazzulali da'a-wul laaha mukhliseena lahud deena fa-lammaa najjaahum ilal barri faminhum muqtasid; Wa-maa yajhadu bi-Aayaatinaa illaa kullu khattaarin kafoor

33.t: O humanity! Be mindful of your Lord, and beware of a Day when no parent will be of any benefit to their child, nor will a child be of any benefit to their parent. Surely Allah’s promise is true. So do not let the life of this world deceive you, nor let the Chief Deceiver deceive you about Allah
33.tr: Yaaa-ayyuhan naasut taqoo Rabbakum wakhshaw Yawmal laa yajzee waalidun 'anw waladihee Wa-laa mawloodun huwa jaazin 'anw waalidihee shai'aa; innaa wa'dal laahi haqqun falaa taghurran-nakumul hayaatud dunyaa Wa-laa yaghur-rannakum billaahil gharoor

34.t: Indeed, Allah ˹alone˺ has the knowledge of the Hour. He sends down the rain, and knows what is in the wombs. No soul knows what it will earn for tomorrow, and no soul knows in what land it will die. Surely Allah is All-Knowing, All-Aware
34.tr: Innal laaha 'indahoo 'ilmus saa'ati Wa-yunazzilul ghaisa Wa-ya'lamu maa fil arhaami Wa-maa tadree nafsum maazaa taksibu ghadaa; Wa-maa tadree nafsum bi-ayyi ardin tamoot; innal laaha 'Aleemun Khabeer
